name: The PaperHands Arena
description: A three-round browser survival game with AI-generated pressure broadcasts and a NEAR Testnet stake vault. Players who flee give up a portion of their balance, which goes directly to the players still inside.
problem: Social survival games often give players no meaningful choice when they walk away. This arena makes each exit change the other players' positions through a fixed, verifiable redistribution rule.
userFlow: Run npm ci --omit=dev and npm run dev with Node.js 22. Open the local URL to see the practice lobby.
With Fast-forward enabled, click Enter, Hold position, and Advance round. See a simulated player flee and the remaining balances rise.
Keep holding and advancing to settle, or reset and confirm Flee to see your refund and tax.
Run npm run test:arena to check conservation, round deadlines, and payout behavior.
